GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

2. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

13. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

14. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
